title: Otori Emu — Smirk Of A Winner〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, here we go! And, action!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I was born into a family of warriors. If I must wield a blade to defend these children, then I shall...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hiyah!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
“Your determination is admirable!
Unfortunately, the Minamoto clan must end here! Prepare yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa☆
Nene's putting on such a powerful performance!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And she's moving so convincingly!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“No, he's too strong...
R-Retreat! Retreeeat!”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Foolish humans...
Such is your punishment for desecrating these mountains with your filthy footprints...”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The way he's moving is riveting. It's like he's a real tengu.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That was awesome...!
Rui just swatted away those Taira henchmen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “I have no interest in restoring the Minamoto clan to its former glory, but making a plaything of brutes such as yourself is all too enticing.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “So, shall we go stir things up in this world a little?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Your name is Benkei, correct...?
Come with me. You will surely enjoy what we are going to see together.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoooaaa☆ That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You and Nene both did an excellent job of capturing your respective characters' traits, even while wielding weapons, Rui.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And we got to play the people fighting against them. We essentially had the best seats in the house!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We appreciate you saying that.
And thank you for playing those characters for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The final showdown between you and Tsukasa was also really amazing, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was blown away by the way you swung around that naginata, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They did all practice a ton☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I was most blown away by what you did during that fight, Emu! I still can't believe the way you jumped over his head to take his back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was so cool when you poked him with your fan...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys! Getting showered with all this praise is starting to make me feel a little embarrassed, but I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even we were stunned by your physical feats this time around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We knew that you were a great athlete, but you really never cease to amaze us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right?! I mean, the way you jumped around and just barely dodged all his attacks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I wish I could do what you can.
Have you been good at sports and stuff ever since you were little, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I was the fastest runner at my elementary school!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, we have a winner☆
I had a feeling you'd say that, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's very easy to imagine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. You're good at basically every sport, Emu, so I bet you do really well during P.E.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I always liked taking on different roles during class, and I still do even today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Different roles?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Like... Being the person who passes the ball or the goalkeeper!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, if I ended up scoring all the goals or points, then others who want to wouldn't get that chance. They'd end up feeling really sad, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Which is why I like doing different things!
So that everyone gets to have fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's so kind of you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
And I guess you've always been like this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like you've been doing everything you can since you were little to make sure those around you smile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet all the classes you've been in have been super fun and full of smiles♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to think you're right about that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we can't help but smile whenever we're with her. There's really never a dull moment.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, since she always manages to find a way to make things fun for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A great athlete who cares deeply about her team and knows how to lead them to victory...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Imagine if you were born a few centuries earlier. You very well could have been Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we decided to have you play him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway!
I'm gonna keep improving my acting skills!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna put even bigger smiles on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to that!
